from fixtures import Fixture, load_fixtures, ROWS
from portion import percent_of_total

KEYS = sorted(set(k for k, _ in ROWS))
TOTAL = sum(v for _, v in ROWS)


def test_percent():
    key = ROWS[0][0]
    part = sum(v for k, v in ROWS if k == key)
    assert abs(percent_of_total(list(load_fixtures()), key) - 100.0 * part / TOTAL) < 1e-6


def test_percentages_add_up():
    data = list(load_fixtures())
    assert abs(sum(percent_of_total(data, k) for k in KEYS) - 100.0) < 1e-6


def test_everything():
    assert abs(percent_of_total([Fixture("a", 4), Fixture("a", 6)], "a") - 100.0) < 1e-6


def test_unknown_key():
    assert percent_of_total(list(load_fixtures()), "zzz") == 0
